source.name: College Football Power Index
source.description: ESPN FPI and published efficiency components. FPI is on a points-above/below-average scale; ESPN efficiency components are opponent-adjusted inputs to the FPI system.

governance: Independent model/display input. Market spread is never used to construct FPI. Missing values remain null.

fpi.description: Football Power Index that measures team's true strength on net points scale; expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.

fpirank.description: Football Power Index Rank vs all FBS teams.

projectedw.description: Projected overall W-L, accounting for results to date and FPI-based projections for remaining scheduled games (and potential conference championship games). May not sum to a whole number because of differing number of games played in each simulation.

projectedl.description: Projected overall Losses, accounting for results to date and FPI-based projections for remaining scheduled games (including potential conference championship games). May not sum to a whole number because of differing number of games played in each simulation.

probwinout.description: Percent of season simulations in which team won all remaining scheduled games as well as conference championship game (if applicable).

probwinconf.description: Percent of season simulations in which team won its conference, incorporating chance of getting to and winning conference championship game (if applicable). Accounts for shared conference titles in conferences that allow them.

sosremainingrank.description: Rank among all FBS teams of remaining schedule strength, from perspective of an average FBS team.

accomplishment.description: Reflects chance that an average Top 25 team would have team's record or better, given the schedule. On a 0 to 100 scale, where 100 is best.

accomplishmentrank.description: Strength of Record rank. Reflects chance that an average Top 25 team would have team's record or better, given the schedule.

adjwins.description: Team's Wins adjusted for chance an average FBS team would have team's record or better, given the schedule.

adjlosses.description: Team's Losses adjusted for chance an average FBS team would have team's record or better, given the schedule.

gamecontrol.description: Reflects chance that an average Top 25 team would control games from start to end the way this team did, given the schedule. On a 0 to 100 scale, where 100 is best.

gamecontrolrank.description: Game Control rank. Reflects chance that an average Top 25 team would control games from start to end the way this team did, given the schedule.

adjavgingamewp.description: Team's average in-game win probability adjusted for chance that an average FBS team would control games from start to end the way this team did, given the schedule.

avgingamewp.description: Team's average in-game win probability across all plays of all games played, not adjusted for site or opponent.

avgingamewprank.description: Team's average in-game win probability rank adjusted for chance that an average FBS team would control games from start to end the way this team did, given the schedule.

avgsosrank.description: Rank among all FBS teams of games already played schedule strength, from perspective of an average Top 25 team.

topsosrank.description: Rank among all FBS teams of games already played schedule strength, from perspective of an top FBS team.

epaoffense.description: Offensive component of FPI. Offensive contribution to expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.

epadefense.description: Defensive component of FPI. Defensive contribution to expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.

epaspecialteams.description: Special teams component of FPI. Special teams contribution to expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.

probwindiv.description: Percent of season simulations in which team won its conference division, for those conferences that have divisions.

probmakeplayoffs.description: Chance to make the CFB Playoff, according to the Playoff Predictor.

probmaketitlegame.description: Chance to make the CFB Playoff National Championship game, according to the Playoff Predictor.

probwintitle.description: Chance to win the CFB Playoff National Championship, according to the Playoff Predictor.

rankchange7days.description: FPI Rank change from previous week.

prob6wins.description: Percent of season simulations in which a team won at least 6 games (typically bowl-eligible).

offefficiency.description: Offensive efficiency on 0-100 scale; based on offense's contribution to scoring margin on per-play basis, adjusted for strength of opposing defenses faced.

offefficiencyrank.description: Team's offensive efficiency rank among all FBS teams.

defefficiency.description: Defensive efficiency on 0-100 scale; based on defense's contribution to scoring margin on per-play basis, adjusted for strength of opposing offenses faced.

defefficiencyrank.description: Team's defensive efficiency rank among all FBS teams.

stefficiency.description: Special teams efficiency on 0-100 scale; based on special teams' contribution to scoring margin on per-play basis, adjusted for strength of opposing special teams faced.

stefficiencyrank.description: Team's special teams efficiency rank among all FBS teams.

totefficiency.description: Net efficiency on 0-100 scale; incorporates offense, defense and special teams efficiencies into a single schedule-adjusted measure of per-play efficiency.

totefficiencyrank.description: Team's overall efficiency rank among all FBS teams.

offefficiency.description: Offensive efficiency on 0-100 scale; based on offense's contribution to scoring margin on per-play basis, adjusted for strength of opposing defenses faced.

offefficiencyrank.description: Team's offensive efficiency rank among all FBS teams.

defefficiency.description: Defensive efficiency on 0-100 scale; based on defense's contribution to scoring margin on per-play basis, adjusted for strength of opposing offenses faced.

defefficiencyrank.description: Team's defensive efficiency rank among all FBS teams.

stefficiency.description: Special teams efficiency on 0-100 scale; based on special teams' contribution to scoring margin on per-play basis, adjusted for strength of opposing special teams faced.

stefficiencyrank.description: Team's special teams efficiency rank among all FBS teams.

totefficiency.description: Net efficiency on 0-100 scale; incorporates offense, defense and special teams efficiencies into a single schedule-adjusted measure of per-play efficiency.

totefficiencyrank.description: Team's overall efficiency rank among all FBS teams.

fpi.description: Football Power Index that measures team's true strength on net points scale; expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.

fpirank.description: Football Power Index Rank vs all FBS teams.

projectedw.description: Projected overall W-L, accounting for results to date and FPI-based projections for remaining scheduled games (and potential conference championship games). May not sum to a whole number because of differing number of games played in each simulation.

projectedl.description: Projected overall Losses, accounting for results to date and FPI-based projections for remaining scheduled games (including potential conference championship games). May not sum to a whole number because of differing number of games played in each simulation.

probwinout.description: Percent of season simulations in which team won all remaining scheduled games as well as conference championship game (if applicable).

probwinconf.description: Percent of season simulations in which team won its conference, incorporating chance of getting to and winning conference championship game (if applicable). Accounts for shared conference titles in conferences that allow them.

sosremainingrank.description: Rank among all FBS teams of remaining schedule strength, from perspective of an average FBS team.

accomplishment.description: Reflects chance that an average Top 25 team would have team's record or better, given the schedule. On a 0 to 100 scale, where 100 is best.

accomplishmentrank.description: Strength of Record rank. Reflects chance that an average Top 25 team would have team's record or better, given the schedule.

adjwins.description: Team's Wins adjusted for chance an average FBS team would have team's record or better, given the schedule.

adjlosses.description: Team's Losses adjusted for chance an average FBS team would have team's record or better, given the schedule.

gamecontrol.description: Reflects chance that an average Top 25 team would control games from start to end the way this team did, given the schedule. On a 0 to 100 scale, where 100 is best.

gamecontrolrank.description: Game Control rank. Reflects chance that an average Top 25 team would control games from start to end the way this team did, given the schedule.

adjavgingamewp.description: Team's average in-game win probability adjusted for chance that an average FBS team would control games from start to end the way this team did, given the schedule.

avgingamewp.description: Team's average in-game win probability across all plays of all games played, not adjusted for site or opponent.

avgingamewprank.description: Team's average in-game win probability rank adjusted for chance that an average FBS team would control games from start to end the way this team did, given the schedule.

avgsosrank.description: Rank among all FBS teams of games already played schedule strength, from perspective of an average Top 25 team.

topsosrank.description: Rank among all FBS teams of games already played schedule strength, from perspective of an top FBS team.

epadefense.description: Defensive component of FPI. Defensive contribution to expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.

epaspecialteams.description: Special teams component of FPI. Special teams contribution to expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.

avgsosrank.description: Rank among all FBS teams of games already played schedule strength, from perspective of an average Top 25 team.

topsosrank.description: Rank among all FBS teams of games already played schedule strength, from perspective of an top FBS team.

epaoffense.description: Offensive component of FPI. Offensive contribution to expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.

epadefense.description: Defensive component of FPI. Defensive contribution to expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.

epaspecialteams.description: Special teams component of FPI. Special teams contribution to expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.

probwindiv.description: Percent of season simulations in which team won its conference division, for those conferences that have divisions.

probmakeplayoffs.description: Chance to make the CFB Playoff, according to the Playoff Predictor.

probmaketitlegame.description: Chance to make the CFB Playoff National Championship game, according to the Playoff Predictor.

probwintitle.description: Chance to win the CFB Playoff National Championship, according to the Playoff Predictor.

rankchange7days.description: FPI Rank change from previous week.

prob6wins.description: Percent of season simulations in which a team won at least 6 games (typically bowl-eligible).

offefficiency.description: Offensive efficiency on 0-100 scale; based on offense's contribution to scoring margin on per-play basis, adjusted for strength of opposing defenses faced.

offefficiencyrank.description: Team's offensive efficiency rank among all FBS teams.

defefficiency.description: Defensive efficiency on 0-100 scale; based on defense's contribution to scoring margin on per-play basis, adjusted for strength of opposing offenses faced.

defefficiencyrank.description: Team's defensive efficiency rank among all FBS teams.

stefficiency.description: Special teams efficiency on 0-100 scale; based on special teams' contribution to scoring margin on per-play basis, adjusted for strength of opposing special teams faced.

stefficiencyrank.description: Team's special teams efficiency rank among all FBS teams.

totefficiency.description: Net efficiency on 0-100 scale; incorporates offense, defense and special teams efficiencies into a single schedule-adjusted measure of per-play efficiency.

totefficiencyrank.description: Team's overall efficiency rank among all FBS teams.

fpi.description: Football Power Index that measures team's true strength on net points scale; expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.

fpirank.description: Football Power Index Rank vs all FBS teams.

projectedw.description: Projected overall W-L, accounting for results to date and FPI-based projections for remaining scheduled games (and potential conference championship games). May not sum to a whole number because of differing number of games played in each simulation.

projectedl.description: Projected overall Losses, accounting for results to date and FPI-based projections for remaining scheduled games (including potential conference championship games). May not sum to a whole number because of differing number of games played in each simulation.

probwinout.description: Percent of season simulations in which team won all remaining scheduled games as well as conference championship game (if applicable).

probwinconf.description: Percent of season simulations in which team won its conference, incorporating chance of getting to and winning conference championship game (if applicable). Accounts for shared conference titles in conferences that allow them.

sosremainingrank.description: Rank among all FBS teams of remaining schedule strength, from perspective of an average FBS team.

accomplishment.description: Reflects chance that an average Top 25 team would have team's record or better, given the schedule. On a 0 to 100 scale, where 100 is best.

accomplishmentrank.description: Strength of Record rank. Reflects chance that an average Top 25 team would have team's record or better, given the schedule.

adjwins.description: Team's Wins adjusted for chance an average FBS team would have team's record or better, given the schedule.

adjlosses.description: Team's Losses adjusted for chance an average FBS team would have team's record or better, given the schedule.

gamecontrol.description: Reflects chance that an average Top 25 team would control games from start to end the way this team did, given the schedule. On a 0 to 100 scale, where 100 is best.

gamecontrolrank.description: Game Control rank. Reflects chance that an average Top 25 team would control games from start to end the way this team did, given the schedule.
